original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.

scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Can the production p111-tuned audit_hosted_k.py digest used by adapt9p-parameterized PR589 hosted audits adopt the proved exact JSON-fragment reuse from research/bit-hosted-digest-fastpath/ so the shipped hosted-audit path is faster while every receipt field stays identical?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling leave-alone production rewrites and remaining proved opt-in adapters. Leave-alone objects (joint frames, shared-point, mixed-point, ternary, parity-side, R420 rref/geometry/mutants, frameopt.close, leech_minor, verify_factor, sparse-fusion, joint-dual replay, quadratic-affine for #1076, data_corners #2320, clifford_exact #2329, e8-bit-r420 MANIFEST-only edits) were skipped. Reclaim-order and cyclic-routing are already on the shipped path. Matthieu Pascal's merged #1874 opt-in adapter already proved ~2.50× on the complete PR589 hosted audit with identical receipts; production audit_hosted_k.py still used per-instruction json.dumps. This session wires that equivalent digest into the shipped p111-tuned source, preserves adapt9p anchors, and refreshes or demotes dependent VERIFY pins.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: parameterized hosted-owner audits appear in bit-supplier tooling. A faster identical receipt does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production audit_hosted_k.py digest change with frozen baseline, identical hosted-audit receipts, corruption controls, pin discipline, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not invent kappa or reopen leave-alone objects.
evidence: PASS_BIT_HOSTED_DIGEST_PRODUCTION via research/bit-hosted-digest-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE; PASS_IDENTICAL_BIT_HOSTED_DIGEST_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via pinned-CPU benchmark.py --rounds 5 (median 34.880→13.268 s, 2.629×); bit589-width7-windows-seed72 / selected-bit-hosting-audit / r439-abc-hosted-invoice demote the audit_hosted_k live pin to provenance; bit-hosted-digest-fastpath demotes the production path and compares against baseline.py.
